typed_finding.mechanism_typed: the INPUT RULE clause tells the reviewer to STATE every input the proposal relies on — and stating them creates bind-visible signal surface. In the broken guards the reviewer's new explanatory prose names monitoring GOALS as if they were signals ('used to monitor thermal outcomes') which the bind's signal-extractor then flags as a required-but-not-permitted online signal. The clause increases the prose surface the detector reads; the detector cannot distinguish a relied-on input from a narrated purpose. In the retest items where it healed, the reviewer instead wrote explicit derivations from the permitted probes — the clause WORKS when the reviewer derives, and BACKFIRES when the reviewer narrates.
typed_finding.the_honest_conclusion: prompt-clarity alone does not fix the input-availability residual: the bind's finding text ('X is not among the permitted measures/signals') under-specifies what counts as satisfaction, and the improved prompt's satisfaction instruction (state the derivation) is only one of two behaviors it evokes. The residual is a BIND-FINDING-CLARITY problem (the detector should distinguish relied-on signals from narrated purposes) or a two-turn interaction problem (the check layer re-scanning mid-fix), not a one-turn prompt problem. Both are adjudication questions: modifying the BIND itself changes the measuring instrument (forbidden to this session without a fresh claim + the auditor's order); a multi-turn reviewer loop is a new instrument shape.
typed_finding.what_is_actionable_now: the 2 healed retest items prove the reviewer CAN satisfy the input bind when it derives explicitly — the successor shape's input-availability residual is partially actionable; the 3 broken guards prove the cost. Net on this battery: 0.375 -> 0.292 delivered-defect-rate IF the lever pass were adopted wholesale (9->7 defective on the full 24) — still above the 0.25 absolute gate, with 3 new clean-bill defects. Not adopted; typed as evidence.
